memories.memory: I believe skilled tradespeople should have strong unions and predictable pensions, although I get frustrated when union officials spend more time on politics than on protecting workers.
I usually support higher taxes on large companies if the money is clearly used for hospitals, vocational schools, and public transport rather than disappearing into administration.
I was raised in an Orthodox Christian household, and although I do not attend services every week, I still light a candle for my parents and say a short prayer before important competitions.

I voted for an independent candidate in the last local election because he promised to publish every council contract, and I gave his campaign the equivalent of about 120 euros from my workshop savings.
I think immigration should be controlled through clear laws and proper work permits, but I dislike people blaming foreign workers for problems caused by poor management and low wages.
After a coworker was dismissed for criticizing our factory's safety rules in 2019, I became more suspicious of governments and employers that demand loyalty while refusing to accept criticism.

My strongest political conviction is that communities work best when people contribute to one another, so I would rather see funding for apprenticeships and neighborhood sports clubs than another expensive government publicity campaign.
